description: After request_exact_quote, IVSS emails the user a confirm link and gives you a fetch_id. Once the user has clicked that link, call this with the fetch_id to show the itemised exact price (sea freight and export costs, destination costs) in the chat. Before the user confirms it returns nothing but a reminder to click the link.
name: get_confirmed_quote
title: Show the exact IVSS price after the user confirmed their email
